clue.text: Herb Isabella used on her head

definitions.meaning: a fragrant kitchen herb used in pesto
in Keats's poem Isabella buries her murdered lover's head in a pot of this herb

explanation.walkthrough: Keats's poem 'Isabella, or the Pot of Basil' is the literary reference behind the second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a common culinary herb, and in Keats's poem the heroine plants it over her lover's buried head in a garden pot.

clue.text: Quiet place to go about having a row

definitions.meaning: a sleepy, isolated spot away from the main current of life

definitions.text: to go about having a row
definitions.meaning: rowers reverse the boat by pushing the oars backwards against the water

explanation.definitionFit: A stagnant arm of a river is a sleepy, isolated spot; as a verb it means to reverse a rowing boat by pushing the oars.

clue.text: Young man succeeded with canter

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded in family trees
a canter is one who cants, a sanctimonious hypocrite, i.e. a prig

explanation.surface: A young man who succeeded in riding at a canter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Canter' looks like a horse's pace, but here it means someone who talks cant: a self-righteous prig.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprig is an old, mildly dismissive word for a youth or stripling.

clue.text: Securing entry for race, at the end of the day

definitions.text: at the end of the day

indicators.note: the race's letters make an entry into the word for securing

parts.note: lashing is the act of securing something with rope
the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Getting an entry form in for a race just before the deadline.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something just before bed means doing it at the close of the day.

clue.text: Dismiss kind of trouble-maker

parts.note: to dismiss an employee is to fire them
a brand is a kind or make of product

explanation.surface: Sacking a certain sort of agitator.
explanation.definitionFit: A firebrand is an agitator who stirs up unrest.

clue.text: Italian monk is supported by French money

indicators.note: in a down clue one piece sits on another, the word is being held up by the currency

parts.note: the franc was France's currency before the euro

explanation.surface: An Italian monk living off French funds.
explanation.walkthrough: St Francis of Assisi is the Italian monk. 'Supported by' is loose here: in the grid the currency comes first, above IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Francis of Assisi founded the Franciscan order of friars in Italy.

clue.text: Try again to get something going in bed

definitions.text: Try again to get something going in bed

parts.words: Try again to get something going in bed
parts.note: sounds like a second romantic attempt, but means putting a seedling back into a garden bed

explanation.definitionFit: To set a plant in soil once more is to try again to establish it growing in a flower bed.

clue.text: Show disapproval through giving the bird

parts.note: to boo is to jeer in disapproval
by means through, as in by way of

explanation.surface: An audience jeering a performer and giving them the bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Giving the bird' is the idiom for booing an act, but 'giving' is only a link and 'the bird' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The booby is a tropical seabird related to the gannet.

clue.text: Spoken mistakes in grammar

indicators.note: said out loud, the word for mistakes gives a near-identical spoken form

parts.note: accidents are mistakes or mishaps

explanation.surface: Errors in speech that break the rules of grammar.
explanation.definitionFit: Accidence is the branch of grammar dealing with inflections of words.

clue.text: Arrange appearance in theatrical circles

definitions.meaning: to ... a window or a line of troops is to arrange it
on stage, costume and the ... circle are the theatre's sense

explanation.definitionFit: To arrange troops in line is to dress them; in the theatre a costume gives an actor's look, and the dress circle is a tier.

clue.text: He's not to be trusted with diamonds

definitions.text: He's not to be trusted with diamonds

parts.words: He's not to be trusted with diamonds
parts.note: sounds like a jewel thief, but diamonds is a suit of playing cards, so a cheat at cards

explanation.definitionFit: A cheat at card games cannot be trusted with any suit, diamonds included.

clue.text: Where to use chalk at the appropriate time

definitions.meaning: snooker players chalk the tip of their stick
exactly when expected, like an actor hitting a prompt

explanation.definitionFit: Billiard players rub chalk on the tip of their stick; an actor arriving punctually as prompted does so on time.

clue.text: Isle of Man?

parts.note: the island name is also an archaic word for a person, so an isle named for a man

explanation.definitionFit: The Isle of Wight is an English island, and wight is an old word for a human being.

clue.text: One is careful going ahead round extremely bad whirlpool

indicators.note: the first pieces go round the letters taken from bad
the careful word is placed in front of the other pieces

parts.note: chary means cautious or wary
I is the Roman numeral one
S stands for is, as in the shortened form 's

indicators.note: only the outermost letters of the word bad are taken

explanation.surface: A cautious person sailing forward past a dangerous whirlpool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One is careful' reads as a cautious person, but it splits into three pieces; Charybdis is the whirlpool of Greek myth facing Scylla.
explanation.definitionFit: Charybdis is the whirlpool of Greek myth opposite the monster Scylla.

clue.text: Imaginary, lines — none included in edited script

indicators.note: the zero is placed within the rearranged letters
a script that is edited has its letters reworked

parts.note: O is a zero, nothing at all

explanation.surface: Imaginary lines with nothing to say in a revised screenplay.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Edited' rearranges SCRIPT to TRPICS, and 'included in' puts O inside it. The tropics of Cancer and Capricorn are imaginary lines of latitude.
explanation.definitionFit: The two parallels of latitude bounding the torrid zone are notional lines drawn on maps.

clue.text: Agreed on a fizzy drink

indicators.note: fizzy suggests the letters are bubbling and stirred up

explanation.surface: Agreeing on a fizzy drink to share.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fizzy' looks like part of the drink's description but is the anagram signal on AGREED ON A.
explanation.definitionFit: Orangeade is a sweet fruit-flavoured soft beverage, often carbonated.

clue.text: A ribbon for the best granny

parts.note: top means the best, as in top quality
a granny is a type of knot

explanation.surface: Giving a ribbon to the finest grandmother.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Granny' is not a grandmother but the granny knot.
explanation.definitionFit: A topknot is a bow or ribbon worn on the crown of the head.

clue.text: Put heavy coat over drunk

definitions.meaning: covered thickly, as a wall is rendered

explanation.definitionFit: A wall rendered with a thick layer has been coated; slang also uses the word for someone very intoxicated.

clue.text: Act of crafty cheater, extremely risky

definitions.text: Act of crafty cheater, extremely risky

indicators.note: crafty suggests the letters are cunningly rearranged
only the outermost letters of risky are used

explanation.surface: A dishonest person's sly deed, and very dangerous.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crafty' rearranges CHEATER to TREACHE, and 'extremely' adds RY, the first and last letters of 'risky'. The whole clue also describes the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Betrayal is the deed of a cunning cheat, and a perilous one.

clue.text: Source of arsenic in certain fish

parts.note: real means certain or genuine
the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.surface: Poison found in a particular kind of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Realgar is an orange-red mineral, arsenic sulphide, mined as an ore of arsenic.

clue.text: Improving newspaper covers up divorce decree

indicators.note: the newspaper word wraps around the decree

parts.note: a rag is a disparaging word for a newspaper

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the decree is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a decree nisi is the provisional order in a divorce

explanation.surface: A tabloid hushing up someone's divorce to improve things.
explanation.walkthrough: A decree nisi is the provisional stage of an English divorce; the surface's 'covers up' reads as hushing, but 'up' alone signals the reversal in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Raising standards means making them better.

clue.text: Describing people closely associated with cats

definitions.meaning: conjoined twins were called by this name after the famous pair from Siam
a blue-eyed breed of cat from Thailand

explanation.definitionFit: Conjoined twins are inseparably linked people, named after a famous pair from Thailand, also home of a pale blue-eyed cat breed.

clue.text: Place to play for Spanish leaders, and Italian

parts.note: the leading letters of the word Spanish are S and P

explanation.surface: A playground for Spanish chiefs and an Italian.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spanish leaders' are S and P, the first two letters, spelt out with the 'and'.
explanation.definitionFit: Children dig and play in a box of sand at a playground.

clue.text: African hunter almost gets a wild beast — what a drama

indicators.note: the last letter of the hunter is dropped

parts.note: Pygmy peoples of central Africa are forest hunters
a lion is a wild beast

explanation.surface: An African hunter nearly gets savaged by a lion: how dramatic.
explanation.walkthrough: Pygmalion is Shaw's play; 'what a drama' is a cryptic exclamation pointing to it.
explanation.definitionFit: Pygmalion is George Bernard Shaw's stage play about Eliza Doolittle.

clue.text: A drop-out displays some art

indicators.note: out signals the letters are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A school drop-out shows off some art.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drop-out' looks like a person; 'out' is the anagram signal on A DROP. The Prado is Madrid's great art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: The Prado museum in Madrid exhibits a great collection of paintings.

clue.text: Book old weight-lifter

definitions.meaning: the Titan of Greek myth who held up the heavens

explanation.definitionFit: A bound volume of maps, and the Titan of myth condemned to hold up the sky.

clue.text: Head of Constabulary has helmet on — what's the matter?

parts.note: a topi is a sun helmet, a pith helmet

indicators.note: only the first letter of Constabulary is used

explanation.surface: A police chief in his helmet asking what the trouble is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' places the helmet in front of the C.
explanation.definitionFit: A subject or theme is the matter under discussion.

clue.text: Filled out vote

definitions.meaning: to ... for a candidate is to vote for one alone

explanation.definitionFit: Rounded and chubby describes a filled-out figure; to choose one candidate decisively is to plump for them.

clue.text: It sounds as if a bride's accessory has to be effective

indicators.note: the clue says the wedding item is heard rather than written

parts.note: a veil is worn by a bride

explanation.surface: A bride's veil must look effective.
explanation.definitionFit: To be of use or help means to work successfully.

clue.text: Meaning to take a foreign hound

parts.note: the import of something is its meaning
une is the French for a

explanation.surface: Intending to adopt a dog from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hound' looks like a dog but is a verb: to pester.
explanation.definitionFit: To pester someone persistently with demands is to harass them.

clue.text: Charge in error

explanation.definitionFit: Supervision of something means being in charge; a slip from inattention is a mistake.

clue.text: Take exercise violently, finally becoming semi-conscious

parts.note: do means take, as in do drugs
PE is physical education, exercise

indicators.note: only the final letter of violently is used

explanation.surface: Working out too hard and ending up dazed.
explanation.definitionFit: Dopey means drowsy and stupefied, only half awake.
